Applying the updates that remain effective gives these checkpoints (including the initial $1,870K budget):

| Records processed | Budget, using final effective updates |
|---|---:|
| #0001–#0400 | $921K |
| Through #0800 | −$1,274K |
| Through #1200 | $360K |
| Through #1500 | $1,300K |
| Through #1600 | $845K |

As a final arithmetic check, effective updates in #1501–#1600 contain $1,170K in increases and $1,625K in decreases: a net decrease of $455K. Thus, $1,300K − $455K = $845K.

ANSWER: $845K
